final_prompt:
Pull the job title, company, location, remote or onsite status, and salary out of this posting and put it in JSON for my job tracker.

<document>
ok so we're finally hiring!!  Brightline Health is looking for a Data Analyst
to join our care-ops team. you'd be working w/ claims + scheduling data, building
dashboards (Tableau, some SQL), and helping clinic managers figure out where
patients are falling through the cracks.

where: our Raleigh, NC office — it's hybrid, so 3 days in, 2 from home
who: 2+ yrs w/ SQL, comfortable explaining numbers to non-data people
perks: $2,000 sign-on bonus!! plus good coffee, flexible hours, health/dental/vision,
401k match up to 5%, and a team that actually likes each other lol

interested? send your resume + a short note to careers@brightlinehealth.example
by end of month. no recruiters pls
</document>
